info.title: New POWWR Utility Meter Lookup Service
info.description:
---
Multi-step Electricity and Gas meter lookup service, to be used at the start of a meter quote journey.

**Typical Usage**
1. Obtain an OAuth token from the POWWR Auth Server
2. Call `/addressSearch` with the site PostCode to retrieve the meter points for the address.
3. Call `/meterSearch` with the desired MeterAddressId or MPAN/MPRN to fetch the meter properties

If MPAN/MPRN is known in advance, step 2 can be skipped.

---

2.2.0

+ Added GasMeter.Ldz
+ Added MeterPointLocation.DeliveryPointAlias
+ Added MeterPointLocation.AdministrativeArea

2.3.0
+ Added ElectricMeter.TradingStatus
+ Corrected casing on example responses
+ Fixed camelCase of property names to match API
+ Changed /addressSearch and /meterSearch response from array to object
+ Removed incorrect quotes on example responses

2.4.0 
+ Added Supplier object, with fields Mpid, ShortCode, Name, EffectiveDate, and PowwrId
+ Added MeterCapacity, DailyMeteredQuantity, CurrentSupplier, IncomingSupplier, and AdditionalInformation to GasMeter

2.5.0 
+ Added meterModel to GasMeter

/Search/addressSearch.description: Performs a lookup on the provided postcode. Returns a set of addresses found in ECOES and XOSERVE data, including IDs for subsequent MeterSearch calls.

postCode.description: Full postcode 6-8 characters; space is expected; no results will be found for a partial postcode

fullAddress.example: PARKWAY HOUSE, PALATINE ROAD, MANCHESTER, M22 4DB

mpans.description: The unique identification numbers of the meters associated with the meter point. Note that these are not guaranteed to return and will be redected to leave the last 3 digits only when they do. The MpanCount will always report the true number.

mprnCount.description: The number of gas meters associated with the meter point

mprns.description: The unique identification numbers of the meters associated with the meter point. Note that these are not guaranteed to return. The MprnCount will always report the true number.

currentSupplierName.description: Note that this field is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.  Please use Current Supplier field.
